data.name: Bilawal
data.gender_notes: Bilawal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bilawal is an Arabic name that signifies high status, exaltation, and grandeur. It is a name that reflects the owner's noble character and elevated position. The name Bilawal carries the meaning “High status, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bilawal usually hope their child will grow to embody high status, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Bilawal is associated with the concept of 'Izzah' (honour and prestige), which is a key aspect of a believer's character.
data.etymology: Bilawal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “High status, Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bilawal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Bilawal
in_english.long_meaning: Bilawal is an Arabic name derived from the root 'FDL' which signifies excellence, nobility, highness, and distinction. In Islamic tradition, this name is regarded as commendable and is often associated with individuals of noble character, high moral standards, and leadership qualities. Historically, the name Bilawal has been used across various Muslim cultures, particularly in South Asia, and symbolizes honor, dignity, and elevated status.

This spiritual connotation is in line with the teachings of Islam, which encourage individuals to strive for self-improvement, moral growth, and a deep connection with their Creator. Through its cultural and spiritual dimensions, the name Bilawal continues to be a powerful source of inspiration for many.
